WHAT CHANGED
GitHub announced Gemini 4 Carbon in Copilot on November 10. It's rolling out to Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise; organization policy may affect access.

WHAT IT DOES
It gives you another model option for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks. That is an invitation to test, not proof it fits your workflow.

WHY BUILDERS SHOULD CARE
A useful model produces work you can verify without creating more cleanup than it saves.

TRY THIS THIS WEEK
Pick one small bug in a public toy repo with an existing test that exposes it. Write the expected behavior and file to change. In fresh sessions, give your current model and Gemini the same brief and context. Work on separate copies from the same starting point.

Check three things:
1. Correctness: does the existing test pass without weakening it?
2. Edit scope: is the diff limited to the requested fix?
3. Usage: what did each attempt cost, including retries?

Skip the switch if access isn't available. Keep your test card for the next candidate.

THE SIGNAL
AI is moving into workflows. Our six-frame storyboard request on Tech Thursday is a small version of the same lesson: specify the deliverable before judging the result. We are proposing this model trial, not reporting a Gemini test from that show.
